name: @tuucho/plugin-tuucho-signin-apple
description: Sign in with Apple into the kernel sign-in shell. Services ID, Key ID, Team ID, and the .p8 private key live here.

clientId.label: Apple Services ID
clientId.description: Services ID from Apple Developer (com.example.siwa). Required before Sign in with Apple appears on the shop.
clientId.sectionDescription: IDs from Apple Developer. The kernel sign-in shell stays on Preferences; fill these to actually connect.

teamId.label: Apple Team ID
teamId.description: 10-character Team ID. Required to sign the client secret with the .p8 key.

keyId.label: Apple Key ID
keyId.description: Key ID of the Sign in with Apple key (.p8) you downloaded.

s2sAudience.label: S2S audience (optional App ID)
s2sAudience.description: Optional App ID used as the server-to-server audience. Leave empty unless Apple documents a separate App ID for this shop.

redirectUri.label: Apple redirect URI
redirectUri.description: Must match Return URLs in the Services ID (this shop’s Apple return path). Wrong host = Apple error.
redirectUri.sectionDescription: Return URL, first-time signup window, and the .p8 private key. The key is never shown after save.

signupTokenTtl.label: Signup token TTL
signupTokenTtl.description: How long a first-time Apple signup token stays valid (for example 10m). Raise only if customers need longer to finish.

privateKey.label: Apple AuthKey PEM (.p8)
privateKey.description: Contents of the .p8 key (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- …). Paste a new PEM only to replace the stored key.
